evidence: Generated category HTML contained an empty grid and depended on client JavaScript for prompt links.
expected_benefit: Give no-JS and non-rendering crawlers direct category-to-article links
recommended_action: Render category cards during the build while retaining client enhancement

evidence: Initial generated title elements exceeded the repository's 65-character validation ceiling.
expected_benefit: Improve concise SERP presentation and keep title metadata within the tested site contract
recommended_action: Use shorter seo_title values without changing visible H1 titles

evidence: Both www host variants failed DNS resolution during baseline and after probes.
expected_benefit: Consolidate accidental www links and avoid an unreachable host variant
recommended_action: If the owner wants www coverage add proxied DNS and a permanent one-hop redirect to the canonical host; otherwise document the intentional absence.

evidence: A dated web-search observation returned stale cached snippets for the removed WWF article and an older page-2 composition even though production redirects are correct.
expected_benefit: Reduce stale search results and accelerate replacement with current canonical pages
recommended_action: Request recrawl/removal in Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools; keep the verified redirects and sitemap current.

evidence: Local Lighthouse LCP ranged from 5.1s to 7.2s after changes; font transfer reached about 0.49-0.88 MB and homepage images about 0.88 MB. No field data was available.
expected_benefit: Improve lab loading behavior without overstating Core Web Vitals impact
recommended_action: Measure production field data first; then test local font subsetting/preload and responsive image srcset for listing/hero media.
